__comment: The post down the middle, drawn on its own so a plant covering the panel can be a separate piece of the same blockstate. Columns 7 and 8 of the texture are the post, and 0 to 6 and 9 to 15 are the two arms one each. Dropped one pixel so it sits in the farmland rather than on top of it, which also lets a stack tile without a seam - the same reason crop_stick_post is drawn that way. One of three, differing only in which texture it takes: the blockstate carries all three in a weighted list so a wall does not repeat on a sixteen pixel grid.
